verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is a SaaS app-building platform, so offering a versioned public API with a deprecation policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no public API, no API versioning scheme, and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file covers support docs only, not a versioned API contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
